name: textbook-socratic-tutor
description: A local textbook-grounded Socratic tutoring app with React, Express, textbook ingestion, concept extraction, retrieval, and optional LLM integration.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run start -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
